interest: Shows 1941 intelligence on Japan's new 100-million-yen naval base and air base on Hainan, Japan's southward staging ground.
overview: Telegram No. 235 (July 1941): American Groff-Smith reports Japan's near-complete 100-million-yen naval base and air base on Hainan, with Army withdrawal leaving the Navy in sole control by August 1941.

people.name: Everitt Groff-Smith
people.role: Commissioner of Chinese Maritime Customs on Hainan Island

subfiles.about: Reports intelligence from Chinese Maritime Customs Commissioner Everitt Groff-Smith regarding Japanese naval and air base construction on Hainan Island and the impending transfer of full administrative control to the Japanese Navy.
subfiles.from: John H. Bruins (American Consulate, Hong Kong)
subfiles.summary: Telegram No. 235: Bruins relays Groff-Smith's report of Japan's near-complete 100-million-yen naval base and air base on Hainan, with the Navy to gain sole control by August 1941.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 235 from Hong Kong (Bruins) on Japanese Naval and Air Base Construction on Hainan Island
